## Checklist

- [ ] Assets are SVG, PNG, JPEG, or WebP and no larger than 5 MiB.
- [ ] SVG files contain no scripts, event handlers, external references, or `foreignObject`.
- [ ] Metadata includes the exact SHA-256 and byte size for every asset.
- [ ] Slugs and legacy IDs are unique.
- [ ] `pnpm validate`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm build` pass locally.
- [ ] I have not added API credentials, deployment secrets, or user wallet data.
